items.question: Approve the complete annotation-ledger-v1 implementation contract before any Phase 1 code or data work begins?

resolution.rationale: The repository owner explicitly approved the complete contract checkpoint.

items.question: Use a provider-neutral, versioned label registry and unified append-only logical tables rather than a constituency-specific or per-run table design?

resolution.authority: explicit approved plan in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: New ordinary label types must pass through the same core lifecycle without core storage or workflow edits.

items.question: Backfill every surviving legacy label and all 15 manifests while preserving raw values, run IDs, unknown provenance, and date-only precision?

resolution.authority: explicit approved legacy policy in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: The append-only ledger must preserve the complete surviving historical record without inventing missing timestamps or responses.

items.question: Keep removed duplicate events historical and non-current, never remapping them to retained copies, while carrying forward fingerprint-identical retained labels?

resolution.authority: explicit approved canonical projection policy in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: The retained copy already has its own labels; removed source material remains historical evidence only.

items.question: Bootstrap-promote reusable primary legacy labels under the explicit human-approved continuity rule?

resolution.authority: explicit approved continuity rule in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: Fingerprint-identical retained text carries forward the existing primary judgment without treating timestamp recency as authority.

items.question: Import only surviving legacy entity rows and create no synthetic empty entity responses?

resolution.authority: explicit approved legacy policy in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: Row absence cannot be upgraded into a reconstructed model response after intermediate responses were discarded.

items.question: Authorize one trusted Codex pass over exactly the 13 corrected transition paragraphs and promote it without representing it as human-validated or independently checked?

resolution.authority: explicit Phase 1 authorization in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: This is a narrow correction overlay using the frozen paragraph-judgment rubric, not broad relabeling or constituency labeling.

items.question: Carry forward the April 3, 1968 press-conference speech labels despite the corrected factual-input mismatch?

resolution.authority: explicit human-approved provisional exception in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: Both legacy models agree on speech_type=press_conference_or_interview, audience=press, and medium=press_conference; the mismatch must remain visible in provenance.

items.question: Retain Opus labels as independent second opinions without bootstrap promotion?

resolution.authority: explicit approved canonical projection policy in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: Independent labels coexist in history; primary continuity does not make the second opinion current.

items.question: Keep constituencies at draft/pilot status with an empty schema-valid typed projection and no production dataset in Phase 1?

resolution.authority: explicit approved constituency scope in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: A later stratified two-pass pilot and publication gate must precede any frozen constituency v1 or full pass.

items.question: Keep execution outside the ledger so core terminal code has no provider client, credentials, model choice, invocation, or network path?

resolution.authority: explicit approved terminal workflow in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: All future adapters must use the same assignment and ingestion path.

items.question: Use immutable sealed artifact sets and complete content-addressed materialization/promotion publications so failures cannot expose partial replacement?

resolution.authority: explicit approved storage model in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: Sealed artifacts are history; Parquet is deterministically rebuildable derived state.

items.question: Accept that backfill preserves surviving final labels but cannot recreate discarded intermediate model responses?

resolution.authority: explicit approved legacy policy in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: The limitation must be recorded rather than filled with invented response artifacts.

items.question: Keep unknown legacy assignment/label timestamps null and infer effort only on exact prompt-hash matches?

resolution.authority: explicit approved legacy policy in user request dated 2026-07-24
resolution.rationale: Date precision and inferred provenance must not be upgraded to timestamps or direct observation.

items.question: Record invocation-tone prompt/cost as unknown and treat its surviving hash as a method-string hash rather than a prompt hash?

resolution.authority: frozen invocation-tone manifest plus approved unknown-provenance policy
resolution.rationale: The legacy artifact predates the provenance layer and must remain honest about what did not survive.

items.question: Does the Codex runtime expose an exact enough model identity for the correction overlay?

resolution.authority: exact Codex runtime metadata exposed for the active turn
resolution.rationale: Runtime metadata exposed model gpt-5.6-sol and reasoning effort xhigh before the first overlay assignment was rendered.

items.source_authority: explicit overlay model-identity gate in user request dated 2026-07-24

items.question: How should the refused mixed-speech frozen-v1 assignment be recovered?

resolution.authority: annotation-ledger-v1 recovery rule and frozen v1 response schema
resolution.rationale: The invalid scheduler batch wrote no response or label event. Preserve it as abandoned work, constrain future frozen-v1 assignments to one speech, and use a new run ID.

items.question: How should the omitted correction-layer files be added to the frozen-input inventory without mutating sealed runs?

resolution.rationale: Do not mutate sealed run inventories. Validate correction outputs against meta_v1 SHA-256 values and append a complete content-addressed inventory covering every paid, correction, raw, and normalized source file.

schema.resolution_rule: An item is resolved only by an explicit resolution record carrying authority, deciding identity, decision, date/time precision, and rationale. No status may be inferred silently.
